summary_text: In February 2026, three independent orders were placed on weekdays (23rd, 26th) and one weekend day (28th). Orders occurred in the evening and morning dayparts. No category combinations, daypart behaviors, or specific product preferences repeated across independent dates. Each order represented a distinct set of shopping needs: a paneer-based meal preparation, a broad staple/dairy/produce restock, and a basic household replenishment of breads and hygiene items. Overall confidence is low due to the lack of repetition across independent dates.
shopping_need_text: Distinct meal preparation ingredients, broad household staple restocking, and basic hygiene/breakfast replenishment.
uncertainty_text: All observed behaviors are based on single independent dates. No durable preferences, routines, or stable patterns can be inferred. Confidence in any inferred behavior pattern is low.
